newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran to launch new airline with Russian planes.
newsitem.headline: Iran to launch new airline with Russian planes.

text.p: The airline of Iran's largest state affiliated conglomerate has bought six Tupolev aircraft for $40 million and leased 16 Antonov cargo planes, an official said on Thursday.
"Bon Air will start operation soon after the delivery of planes which are due to arrive here next January," the official at Bon Air, the airline of Bonyad Mostazafan told Reuters.
He said the planes were Tupolev-154 and Antonov-12.
Mohsen Ragiqdust, the Bonyad chairman, was quoted by Akhbar daily on Thursday as saying to reporters that $40 million was the amount of the contract for the six passenger Tupolevs.
The 16 Antonov cargo leased planes will be delivered two months later, according to Rafiqdust.
